purpose: Test the frozen v12 signed plant-position projection with source-native Dominica Heliconia traits, visitation mixtures and female fitness without refitting the independent bill-to-corolla mapping.

source_native_sampling.plants_per_site: approximately 30-40 focal plants depending on availability
source_native_sampling.corolla_length: 5-10 flowers per plant measured in mm; plant mean used in analyses
source_native_sampling.fitness: seed set per plant derived from seeds/flower x flowers/bract x bracts/plant
source_native_sampling.pollinator_observation: 12 h per site, species and sex of each hummingbird visitor recorded

full_dataset_package_route.route: official Dryad landing-page Download full dataset control in the in-app browser

dryad_files.api_name: Temeles et al Heliconia Bihai Population Data.XLS
dryad_files.role: plant-level floral trait and seed-set data

dryad_files.api_name: Temeles et al Heliconia caribaea red morph population data.XLS
dryad_files.role: plant-level red-morph floral trait and seed-set data

dryad_files.api_name: Temeles et al Heliconia caribaea yellow morph population data.XLS
dryad_files.role: plant-level yellow-morph floral trait and seed-set data

workbook_schema_lock.layout: population-year units are horizontal column blocks; rows below the first header row are plants

source_native_visit_weights.source: Temeles et al. 2013 article Methods and Results; weights were locked after the independent 2011 mapping and before the new exact raw-data target was calculated
source_native_visit_weights.bihai_rule: Female E. jugularis were the sole visitor to H. bihai in every studied population; N=14 visits pooled across H. bihai. Unit-specific counts are not promoted from the pooled N, but the female fraction is exactly 1.0 for each admitted H. bihai unit.
source_native_visit_weights.forbidden_inference: Do not replace these weights with a species-typical sex, infer sex from corolla phenotype, or duplicate the pooled H. bihai N=14 into four unit-specific counts.

independent_mapping_source.title: Plant-pollinator interactions and floral convergence in two species of Heliconia from the Caribbean Islands
independent_mapping_source.role: functional-trait calibration only; no 2013 seed-fitness outcome enters the mapping
independent_mapping_source.source_interpretation: On Dominica, female E. jugularis with long bills are the primary visitors of long-corolla H. bihai, whereas male E. jugularis with shorter bills primarily visit shorter-corolla H. caribaea.

frozen_signed_position_mapping.mapping_type: two-anchor linear mechanical calibration from the independent 2011 Dominica source
frozen_signed_position_mapping.population_year_pollinator_center: Use the locked source-native 2013 sex-specific E. jugularis visitation fraction for the matching population/year/morph; center = female_fraction * 26.6 + (1 - female_fraction) * 19.8 mm.
frozen_signed_position_mapping.signed_position: population mean plant corolla length in mm - expected corolla length in mm
frozen_signed_position_mapping.predicted_selection_direction: negative cross-unit slope: units shorter than the calibrated position should show more positive direct selection on corolla length, and units longer than it should show more negative selection

interpretation.negative: plant lineage mean lies shorter than the 2011 pollinator-calibrated corolla position
interpretation.positive: plant lineage mean lies longer than the 2011 pollinator-calibrated corolla position
interpretation.zero: plant lineage mean lies at the two-anchor calibrated position

target_contract.primary_question: Does signed initial corolla position predict the direction or magnitude of direct female-fitness selection on corolla length across Dominica population-year-morph units?
target_contract.primary_fitness: source-native seeds per plant divided by the unit mean
target_contract.trait_standardization: corolla length and mean bracts per inflorescence are standardized separately within each unit to mean zero and sample variance one
target_contract.primary_selection_response: source-method multivariate direct linear selection gradient beta_multi for standardized corolla, controlling standardized mean bracts per inflorescence
target_contract.source_model_reproduction_check: each reconstructed beta_multi and standard error must match the corresponding published Table 3 or 4 value within 0.015
target_contract.primary_between_unit_model: unweighted OLS: beta_multi_corolla ~ signed_position_mm; each population x year x morph unit receives equal weight
target_contract.unit_of_independence: population x year x morph for selection-gradient comparison; plants are nested observations
forbidden_rescues: do not use the published 2013 selection-gradient sign to choose or alter the mapping
do not choose male versus female pollinator identity after inspecting plant seed-set results
do not infer missing sex-specific visitation weights from the floral phenotype
do not refit the 2011 bill-to-corolla slope against the 2013 fitness outcome
do not drop an admitted population-year-morph because it disagrees with the predicted direction
do not call literature-known selection patterns a fully held-out validation

known_literature_context_not_used_for_ma.article_summary: H. bihai generally shows directional selection for longer corollas; H. caribaea more often shows selection on bract number, with corolla selection less consistent.
known_literature_context_not_used_for_ma.rule: The mapping was frozen before recovery and calculation of the exact raw-data signed-position target. Source-method beta_multi is used regardless of its result.

claim_boundary: This gate opens one cross-sectional natural-selection projection of v12 using a frozen Dominica two-anchor mapping. It is not a universal floral optimum, a fully literature-blind validation, an experimental pollinator shift, or a direct test of historical island transition causation.
